privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This Privacy Policy explains how Syangja Khaja Ghar ("we", "our", "us") collects, uses, discloses, and protects information when you visit or interact with our website.

sections.title: Information We Collect
items: Contact information you provide (name, email, phone number).
Booking and reservation details when you use our services.
Usage data from cookies and analytics tools.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use collected information to: respond to inquiries, provide and improve our services, process reservations, and comply with legal obligations. We may also use aggregated or anonymized data for analytics and business insights.

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
sections.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate our site, remember preferences, and measure performance. You can control cookies through your browser settings; disabling cookies may affect site functionality.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.content: We may share data with trusted third parties (payment processors, analytics providers) only as necessary to provide the service and under confidentiality commitments.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal data we hold about you. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.

sections.title: Security & Retention
sections.content: We take reasonable measures to protect personal information. We retain data only as long as necessary for the purposes described and to satisfy legal obligations.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, email: info@syangjasundar.com
